examples.explanation: The inner groups give 12 and 14; 1 + 11 - 3 = 9, then 9 + 14 = 23.

hints: Track a running total, the current number, and a sign (+1/-1); on '+' or '-' first fold the pending number into the total.
On '(' push the current total and sign onto a stack and restart both; on ')' fold the pending number, then combine with the popped sign and total.
A leading minus (or one right after '(') works naturally if the sign starts at +1 and flips on '-'.
